clauses.statement: Brainbase Core remains LLM-free; semantic intelligence is supplied through a replaceable JudgmentIntelligenceProvider.
Only a direct terminal request to the human is classified; explanatory questions, quoted examples, code blocks and ordinary final answers remain on the existing Stop path.

test_pattern: classifies only hard external boundaries deterministically

clauses.statement: A low-risk reversible human confirmation is rejected without an LLM and converted into an executable continuation instruction.

test_pattern: blocks a low-risk confirmation without invoking an LLM

clauses.statement: A hard production, external communication, financial or contractual boundary is allowed to reach the existing audited Stop path.

test_pattern: allows a hard external-impact boundary to reach the existing audit Stop

clauses.statement: Only semantic gray-zone cases invoke an independent Codex resolver in an empty temporary directory with ephemeral state, read-only sandbox, approval never, ignored user config and rules, structured output, stdin input and a recursion guard.

test_pattern: launches Codex as an isolated read-only structured-output resolver

clauses.statement: The judgment packet includes the explicit task, digest-verified adoption policies and DAG nodes, successful current-turn Brainbase MCP evidence, and available local SSOT decisions, values and judgments, with bounded and redacted event projections.

test_pattern: includes digest-verified current-turn Brainbase evidence and redacts secrets
fails closed on a tampered episode before issuing a continuation
adds Brainbase judgment sources before asking the independent resolver

clauses.statement: Resolver basis identifiers must already exist in the compiled Brainbase packet; invented basis and evidence-free authority, secret or terminal-blocker claims fail closed to same-worker continuation.

test_pattern: rejects invented Brainbase basis ids and falls back to same-worker continuation
does not grant missing-authority escalation without trusted host evidence

clauses.statement: Autonomy decisions are immutable, digest-bound to episode, state and policy snapshot, and idempotent for an identical case.

test_pattern: reuses an immutable decision for the same state and policy snapshot

clauses.statement: The autonomy layer bypasses itself in resolver subprocesses and fails closed when the same continuation repeats during an active Stop repair; changed cases are bounded to two autonomy blocks per turn by default.

test_pattern: fails closed when the same continuation is repeated during an active Stop repair
bypasses the autonomy layer inside the resolver subprocess

clauses.statement: Non-escalation Stop events and HUMAN_REQUIRED decisions preserve the existing Judgment Host audit and final-receipt path.

test_pattern: allows a hard external-impact boundary to reach the existing audit Stop

clauses.statement: The official brainbase binary and generated Codex Hook configuration route UserPromptSubmit, PostToolUse and Stop through the autonomy wrapper while other CLI commands delegate unchanged.

test_pattern: binds all three Codex hooks to the autonomy wrapper
